RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias; in local government, panels frequently comprise available department heads, city managers, and HR directors who happen to be women. 

Furthermore, director-level appointments prioritize political acumen, leadership style, and stakeholder management—such as public consultation—over technical credentials and degrees alone. 

Raising sex or panel demographics without concrete proof of procedural irregularity will severely damage your professional reputation in municipal planning. Instead, send a polite follow-up reiterating your request for constructive debrief feedback. Frame your inquiry entirely around interview performance and competency benchmarks rather than the panel's composition or the successful candidate's background.
